[[Marshall Whitman]] is a renowned explorer of [[Ascalon]]. Together with [[Marshall Tasca]], their exploits are considered legend. Both of them were believed to have perished in the Shiverpeak Mountains.

:''"Let me guess: You heard I'd been killed while exploring the southern range of the Shiverpeaks, right? I get that a lot.  Actually, it was my colleague, and at times my rival, Marshall Tasca, who died on these mountains."''
